moments.title: Kate Bush turns 68
moments.blurb: The iconic British singer-songwriter, known for her unique artistic style and hits like 'Wuthering Heights' and 'Running Up That Hill', celebrates her 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Art-rock icon
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to the one and only Kate Bush! From 'Wuthering Heights' to 'Running Up That Hill', her artistry is truly timeless.

angles.name: Influence & legacy
angles.copy: 68 years young for the legendary Kate Bush! Her innovative music continues to inspire generations. What's your favourite Kate Bush track?

moments.title: Paul Anka celebrates 85th birthday
moments.blurb: The legendary Canadian-American singer-songwriter, known for timeless hits such as 'Diana', 'Lonely Boy', and writing 'My Way', turns 85 today.

angles.name: Pop crooner turns 85
angles.copy: Happy 85th Birthday to the incredible Paul Anka! A true music legend who gave us 'Diana', 'Lonely Boy', and Frank Sinatra's 'My Way'.

angles.name: Songwriting genius
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 85th Birthday to Paul Anka! Responsible for some of the biggest songs of all time, his legacy is unmatched.

moments.title: Robert Cray turns 73
moments.blurb: Five-time Grammy Award-winning American blues guitarist and singer Robert Cray, known for his distinctive soul-blues style, celebrates his 73rd birthday on August 1st.

angles.name: Blues icon
angles.copy: Happy 73rd Birthday to the incredible Robert Cray on August 1st! His soulful blues guitar has won him five Grammys and countless fans.

angles.name: Soul-blues legend
angles.copy: Wishing a fantastic 73rd to blues legend Robert Cray this Saturday! What's your favourite track from the 'Strong Persuader' hitmaker?

moments.title: James Hetfield turns 63
moments.blurb: James Hetfield, co-founder, lead vocalist, and rhythm guitarist of the legendary heavy metal band Metallica, celebrates his 63rd birthday on August 3rd.

angles.name: Metal frontman
angles.copy: Happy 63rd Birthday to the legendary James Hetfield of Metallica on August 3rd! What's your favourite riff from the metal icon?

angles.name: Rock legend
angles.copy: Wishing a headbanging 63rd Birthday to James Hetfield this Monday! The voice and guitar behind so many Metallica anthems.

moments.title: Geri Halliwell turns 54
moments.blurb: Geraldine Estelle Halliwell-Horner, better known as Ginger Spice from the iconic 90s pop group Spice Girls, celebrates her 54th birthday on August 6th.

angles.name: Ginger Spice at 54
angles.copy: Girl Power! Happy 54th Birthday to Geri Halliwell on August 6th! What's your favourite Spice Girls memory?

angles.name: Pop icon birthday
angles.copy: Wishing the fabulous Geri Halliwell a very Happy 54th Birthday this Thursday! Forever Ginger Spice, forever a pop icon.

moments.title: Bruce Dickinson turns 68
moments.blurb: Paul Bruce Dickinson, the legendary lead vocalist of the heavy metal band Iron Maiden, celebrates his 68th birthday on August 7th.

angles.name: Maiden frontman
angles.copy: Up the Irons! Happy 68th Birthday to the iconic Bruce Dickinson of Iron Maiden on August 7th! A true heavy metal legend.

angles.name: Metal legend
angles.copy: Wishing a powerful 68th to Bruce Dickinson this Friday! Beyond the mic, he's also a pilot, fencer, and author.

moments.title: The Edge turns 65
moments.blurb: David Howell Evans, known as The Edge, the lead guitarist, keyboardist, and backing vocalist of the legendary rock band U2, celebrates his 65th birthday on August 8th.

angles.name: U2 guitar maestro
angles.copy: Happy 65th Birthday to U2's iconic guitarist, The Edge, on August 8th! His unique sound has defined generations of rock music.

angles.name: Signature sound
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 65th to The Edge this Saturday! That distinctive guitar tone is instantly recognisable. What's your favourite U2 song?

moments.title: Community Shield: Arsenal v Man City in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The 2026 FA Community Shield, the traditional curtain-raiser for the English football season, will see Premier League champions Arsenal take on FA Cup winners Manchester City at Principality Stadium in Cardiff on Sunday, August 16th.

angles.name: Season opener in Wales
angles.copy: The Community Shield is coming to Cardiff! Arsenal v Man City kicks off the season on August 16th at Principality Stadium. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Premier League vs FA Cup
angles.copy: Football's back! Well, almost. The Community Shield sees Arsenal face Man City on August 16th. A taste of the season to come!

angles.name: Local Welsh buzz
angles.copy: Massive football coming to Principality Stadium! Arsenal v Manchester City for the Community Shield on August 16th. Get ready, Cardiff!
